notesEn: 0.3.66: .gitattributes silences LF/CRLF warnings — Windows core.autocrlf converts session_projcache JSON to CRLF causing push warnings; marked binary + eol=lf for others. Pure config change, no logic changes.
notes: 0.3.66: .gitattributes 消除 LF/CRLF 警告——Windows core.autocrlf 会把 session_projcache JSON 转 CRLF 导致推送警告，标记为 binary + 其余 eol=lf 彻底消除。纯配置改动，逻辑不变。
